_translator_note: Guaraní jopará (Paraguayan Asunción dialect). No academic Guaraní, no DNI-book Spanish. Terms verified with public glossary of TDP (Túumben Démocracia Paraguay) and public SOMOSGAY materials. Where terminology is genuinely contested (e.g. 'orgullo' → used by activists in Spanish), the loanword stays — that mirrors how lgbt+ activists actually talk.
